data.name: Rekha
data.gender_notes: Rekha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rekhā, 'line, streak'. Its root is Sanskrit rekhā (रेखा). A classical Sanskrit term for a line. Rekha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Line; streak; a furrow”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rekha expresses “Line; streak; a furrow”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rekha total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
